tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind the card (warm paper in light, deep green-black in dark).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The card itself, sheets and dialogs. Always paired with shadow-card.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Contact-row hover/pressed state, input fields, the QR panel background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Names, headings and body copy on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and brand-soft (13:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Job title, company, labels and captions on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.5:1+).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: the divider between the header and the contact list. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: the secondary button outline, input borders (3:1+ on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: BizCard teal. The primary action fill ("Kartı Kaydet"), links, icons in contact rows, the focus ring. Also readable as text on surface (6:1 light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. Dark ink in the dark theme because the teal lightens there.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Avatar background, the scan-counter chip, selected states. ink and brand both read on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber, for the meeting moment only: the "Toplantı Talep Et" highlight and the calendar badge. A fill, never text on surface in light (2.2:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (7:1+).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and failed-save messages, always with an icon or the word "Hata" beside it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with a 2px offset on every interactive element.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: The person's name on the card. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and screen titles outside the card (admin panel, share sheet).

styles.name: role
styles.usage: Job title and company under card-name, in ink-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Scan counter, helper text, timestamps, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked buttons and between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Contact-row vertical padding; gap between name and role.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; contact-row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between card sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top margin above the card; gap between the card and the QR panel.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Contact rows, inputs, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The card and the QR panel: the signature soft-rectangle shape.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatar and chips (scan counter).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The card only. Everything else sits flat.
